content.title: About
content.content: Groundhog (720) is a premium plant‑based protein powder designed to support muscle recovery and boost post‑workout energy. The formula is non‑GMO, free from artificial sweeteners and colorants.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Combines pea, rice and hemp proteins to deliver a complete amino acid profile.
Each serving provides 20 g of pure protein.
Enriched with digestive enzymes for better nutrient absorption.
Tested to be free of common allergens, including gluten and lactose.
Packaged in recyclable material to reduce environmental impact.

items.title: Supports muscle growth
items.content: A rich blend of essential amino acids promotes muscle protein synthesis after exercise.

items.title: Increases satiety
items.content: High protein content helps you feel fuller longer, which is useful for weight management.

items.title: Boosts immunity
items.content: Contains B‑vitamins and zinc that support normal immune function.

items.title: Provides steady energy
items.content: Complex carbs from rice deliver a stable energy release without blood‑sugar spikes.

items.title: Easy digestion
items.content: Added enzymes (protease, amylase) improve digestion and reduce bloating.

items.title: Legume allergy
items.content: The product contains pea protein, which may trigger allergic reactions in sensitive individuals.

items.title: High fiber content
items.content: Large doses can cause mild gas or stomach discomfort.

items.title: Not suitable for certain kidney conditions
items.content: Due to purine content, people with gout or severe kidney disease should limit intake.

items.title: Medication interactions
items.content: Protein supplements may affect the efficacy of some drugs, such as anticoagulants.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Mix one scoop (≈30 g) with 250‑300 ml of water, milk, or a plant‑based beverage. For a richer flavor, add fruit, nuts, or oats. Recommended post‑workout or as a protein snack between meals.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store in a cool, dry place with the package tightly sealed. Keep moisture and direct sunlight away. For storage longer than 6 months, refrigerate.
